# CycleNet Time Series Forecasting — Final Experiment Design

v1.0 (design-final), 2026-10-23. Status: design-only; no experiment run; no external empirical number reproduced. Reference: Lin et al., ICLR 2025 (cited as architectural source and motivation only).

Sections (a)–(m) are complete; document closes with an "Execution readiness" subsection listing the exact venv/pip install command, dataset download URLs and MD5 protocol, the pre-compute step for splits/T̃, the single fixed-seed smoke test that gates the main sweep, the launch commands for main matrix and ablations (including the gated A8-internal PatchTST check), and reporting-step commands. Compute budget reconciles to 22.78 h committed + 1.22 h reserve = 24.00 h. Parameter budget is consistent with caps stated in §(a)/(j). U9 (paired-seed bootstrap CI with paired t-test secondary, no FWER correction across horizons), U10 (PatchTST d_model=64 deviation cell explicit with A8-internal re-run gated by checkpoint), and U11 (A8 restricted to ETTh1; "ETTh1 only" annotation required on any H8 plot or table; extrapolation to ETTm1 / Exchange is out of scope) are all explicitly baked into the relevant sections. Awaiting researcher review.
